mainEntity.name: When should I consider custom windows instead of standard-sized windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider custom windows when standard sizes do not fit your existing openings, when you desire a unique architectural style, or when specific performance requirements are critical. This includes homes with non-standard window dimensions, historical properties requiring precise replication, or situations where enhanced energy efficiency, soundproofing, or UV protection is paramount. A key decision factor is whether your aesthetic goals or functional needs cannot be met by off-the-shelf options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider custom windows if standard sizes don't fit, you want a unique architectural style, or specific performance needs like energy efficiency or soundproofing are critical.
